title: 7 Places a Godly Man's Mask Slips First
caption:
Sunday morning doesn't cover Tuesday traffic.

A godly man isn't graded on the version of himself that shows up when people are watching. He's graded on the one that shows up alone at a red light, tired, cut off in traffic, with the search bar open.

Pick one from this list. Let God near it this week instead of managing it.
